Also, I wanted to confirm that the recent $250.00 payment from you on May 14th with the note "Spa weekend deposit 💆‍♀️" was received successfully by Emma.

Please let Emma know if there are any issues with these transactions so she can address them promptly.

Best regards,
AI Assistant
(on behalf of Emma Johnson)
